svg.aria-label: Three behaviours near an equilibrium at the origin. Stable in the sense of Lyapunov: starting inside the small circle of radius delta, the state stays inside the circle of radius epsilon. Asymptotically stable: it also tends to the origin. Unstable: some starts arbitrarily close leave the epsilon circle
